_comment: Generated from the error constructors in keenableai/keenable-backend-ts PRs #663 and #666 (src/shared/utils/api-errors.ts), with sendError's agent-route default guidance and request_id applied, and Date.now fixed at 2026-11-06T12:00:00Z. "source" names the backend test whose expectations each case reproduces. An optional "endpoint" of "fetch" means the case is sent from fetch(); every other case is sent from search(). Kept identical in python/tests, typescript/test and go/testdata.

body.message: Either X-API-Key header or Authorization Bearer token is required
body.fix: Send your Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (or as "Authorization: Bearer <key>") and retry. Create a key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.
body.keyless: /v1/search/public and /v1/fetch/public work without a key, rate-limited per IP. Name your app in the X-Keenable-Title header (or the keenable_title query parameter); public requests without it get a 400.

expect.fix: Send your Keenable API key in the X-API-Key header (or as "Authorization: Bearer <key>") and retry. Create a key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys.
expect.message_contains: Either X-API-Key header or Authorization Bearer token is required

body.message: Invalid API key

body.message: Public API hourly limit reached. Wait 30 minutes to continue or upgrade. More info about authentication & upgrade: curl https://docs.keenable.ai/authentication.md
body.fix: Keyless requests are limited to 1000 per hour per IP address on each endpoint. Retrying before the window resets returns 429 again. To continue now, create a free API key at https://app.keenable.ai/console/api-keys and call /v1/search or /v1/fetch with it in the X-API-Key header: keyed requests have no hourly cap.
